title: Tiered Fastpass: Modular Acceptance Criteria & Deferred-Scope Contracts for Top Accounts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Create a defensible, repeatable admission process for high-impact customer asks that balances commercial commitments with engineering capacity and product strategy. 'Tiered Fastpass' will: 1) classify incoming VIP asks into modular scope units (M1, M2, M3) that can be delivered independently; 2) attach conditional, timeboxed delivery windows and escrow-style fallback deliverables; 3) surface an acceptance checklist and risk score to PM/Eng/Legal before committing. Why: repeated ad-hoc commitments for top accounts are fragmenting roadmap predictability and increasing churn risk. Scope: intake form updates, a scoring algorithm (business value / implementation risk / compliance needs), contract template for deferred-scope delivery, Console feedback channel to record promises, and an operator dashboard for outstanding commitments. Acceptance criteria: - Intake form live and prefilled templates available for Solutions & AE teams - Scoring engine returns classification in <5m and recommended delivery window - Legal-approved deferred-scope contract template stored in Drive for use within 24h - Pilot with 3 strategic accounts within 6 weeks - Dashboard shows outstanding promises, owner, and age; SLAs: >90% of committed modular units either delivered or formally deferred within window Metrics/KPIs: intake-to-decision time (target <72h), commit fulfillment rate (target 90% on pilot), delta in roadmap churn signals from pilot customers, impact on ARR retention. Trade-offs & constraints: - Avoid building heavy contract automation in MVP; use fillable templates + Notion/Drive signing workflow. - Keep scoring engine rule-based initially; ML scoring can be added later. - Some top accounts require bespoke handling; policy must allow exceptions but log them. Rollout plan: 1) internal alpha with Solutions & Legal (2 weeks), 2) pilot with 3 accounts (6 weeks), 3) iterate on scoring thresholds and template language, 4) formalize into SLA playbook and link to PM backlog prioritization. Links & artifacts: Confluence playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Tiered+Fastpass+Playbook, Drive templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-template-folder, Draft PRD: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-fake-prd, Pilot dashboard (Looker): https://looker.redwood.ai/dashboards/commit-dashboard
